main_text.l: uiuo teftatore fuus effe defineret. D.
An nepos illa formula inftitutus, quã
uis lex de fuccedendi tempore nihil
definiat, tamen quia formula filij mor
gis caput tempus non diftínxit,nec de
finijt, ut tantùm poft teftatoris morte
fuccedendi ius effet, non autem ante
fe,filium uiuo patre fuum effe defiffe[?],
lex Cornelia fingit illum eodem decef
fiffe momento, quo captus eft, quia
dius exponit, de qua nos postremo lo

page.notes: The text on this page is set in roman type with a few italic words. The main doubtful readings are "defiffe" (the last letters are blurred, so I marked it [?]) and "deinceps", which is split across a line end. The "§.10" heading is set in italic. Faint marks at the left and right edges are show-through or scan edge and are not transcribed.
